notes:
### 修复

- 开机自启时，有的电脑上会闪一下命令提示符小黑窗，已修好。

### 新功能

- 截图和长截图可以「识别后翻译」：点工具条上的「译」（Ctrl+T），认出文字后直接用 AI 翻译，原文和译文都能改、都能复制；源语言可以自动识别，源语言和目标语言可以在设置里预设，也可以每次在面板里临时改。翻译用的是「设置 → AI 接入」里配置的 AI。
- 可以一键安装「增强识别引擎」（设置 → 截图与录屏 → 文字识别与翻译）：识别中文小字、界面文字比系统自带的准得多，完全离线、不上传图片；下载约 124 MB，不安装也照常用系统自带的识别。

### Fixes

- Fixed a Command Prompt window that briefly appeared on some PCs when the app started with Windows.

### New

- Screenshots and scrolling captures can now translate recognized text: click “Tr” on the toolbar (Ctrl+T) to recognize the text and translate it with AI. Both the original and the translation can be edited and copied. The source language can be auto-detected, and both languages can be preset in Settings or changed each time in the panel. Translation uses the AI configured in Settings → AI.
- One-click install of an enhanced OCR engine (Settings → Screenshot & Recording → Text recognition & translation): much more accurate than the built-in Windows OCR on small Chinese text and UI text, fully offline, never uploads images. About a 124 MB download; without it the built-in OCR still works.
